{07 00 00}I know this is short notice,{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}
but today's the {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00}!
{01 00 00 0a 00}It's so exciting!
{07 1b 00}Today, someone else's trash
could become your treasure!

{07 0d 00}There's something about 
this day{01 00 00 05 00} that gets me so
worked up, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 14 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} you DO
know that today is the day
of the {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00}, right?!
{07 00 00}If you see something you 
like, just pounce on it{01 00 00 05 00}
without hesitation.
{07 1b 00}Good furniture moves fast.{01 01 00}
In a way, it's just like 
love, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 14 00}There's just something 
about used furniture that's
so warm, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00} is so much
more than just buying used
items for cheap!{07 14 00}

{07 04 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}you! {01 00 00 0a 00}Yeah, you! What
are you doing just standing
around here?
{07 15 00}Shouldn't you be manning
the shop or something?
Huh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}Because townsfolk come to
your house,{01 00 00 0a 00} the {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market
{ff 00 00 00}is a chance to meet people.
{07 00 00}So don't go wasting your
time lollygagging
around here!

{07 00 00}Even if you don't have a
Bell to your name, your
home can still feel inviting.
{07 19 00}A successful shop always
feels nice to be in,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{07 14 00}
